text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The time has come once again this year. 
Seize the radiant crown! It's the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An unstoppable Umamusume who stormed onto 
the Classic Tiara trail undefeated and 
continues to rack up a tremendous record!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming her spring injury, the 
legendary witch descends upon the turf 
once more! Will she dazzle us with that 
magic yet again—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And we must not forget! Contrary to her 
laid-back vibe, she's slickly and steadily 
blazed through races—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Fusaichi Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This year's race is once again packed with 
elite talent. I can't wait to see what 
kind of drama will unfold!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—"Don't worry. I arrived safely without 
catching the wrong train or getting lost. 
You just focus on the race."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly. Do I really look that 
directionally challenged?

Right after the Shuka Sho, Fusaichi 
Pandora was even contemplating retirement. 
I was worried sick about what would 
happen, but—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Smooch smooch smooch smooch smooch♡ Love♡ 
Love♡ Hehe~♪ Love♡ Love♡ Mwah mwah♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Is it okay if I take 1st place?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeah, now I'm all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You don't know the Chu-Chu-Chu-Chu 
Dance? Don't you use UmaTok?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Taking pics before the race is totally in 
right now ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it cute? The choreo even includes 
Ai-chan's 'love'~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yup☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Since you said you wanted to learn from my 
serious races today, right~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If I'm being a role model, then like, I 
totally gotta do my best for Ai-chan ♡

Were the tears from that day just an 
illusion? She was in such high spirits it 
made me wonder. Or rather—

Yes, even without any dramatic changes to 
the training routine—

Fusaichi Pandora's conditioning had come 
together at tremendous speed leading up to 
today!

I understand that Almond Eye is your 
motivation. However—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's up, Trainer?

...That said, it's right before the race. 
I want to avoid any exchanges that might 
break her concentration.
choice_data_list: No... you're right. Let's do our best!
No... you're right. Let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hm? Really? Alright then, works for me!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm off♡ Aw yeah, let's do this!

Hoping I could talk to her once she had 
calmed down after the race, the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup began!
